column3: A resubscribe carries resume {start, from} (conversation entry ids) or {rev} (home digest); the server answers with only the entries after the cursor or "nothing changed", and falls back to a snapshot
column4: A reconnect resent a whole conversation snapshot (35 KB in the wire test) and the home snapshot every time; entry ids are immutable, so they are a cursor without a sequence log
